text_block_list.text: "The Strongest Umamusume."

"To reach that place, she took off running.
In search of her own definition of 'the strongest.'"
Looking back on these past three years, I find myself thinking. That title of "the strongest" that she claimed—

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's great!
Give some fan service to the camera... Yes, just like that!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Next, looking cool... that pose is perfect!
Hold that and give me your signature expression, please!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Alright, last one!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "No, no, no matter how you look at it, that last one was definitely out of the question."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, why not?
It gives a nice, matching two-of-a-kind feel, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Nature-san and I are going to be acting as a two-in-one duo for the campaign!

Royce and Royce and Nice Nature were recently
selected to be the official campaign characters
for the URA.

Given their dedicated fanbases, they were
asked to promote the joys of supporting one's faves.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
We need to convey their unique personalities and charms
so everyone can find various Umamusume to cheer for, right?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "First, we have to show them what we're like as regular students so they feel closer to us!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I get what you're saying, Royce, but you know...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"We never strike poses like that usually.
Not in photos, not even in purikura!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. What is demanded of us is to be
the figure that our fans expect to see.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure everyone's looking forward to seeing
Nature-san get flustered and do a cute pose
after I put her on the spot♪"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wha, what's with that!
Wait, was that pose just set up for an impossible demand!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, people find you far cuter
than you think you are, you know.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Now that you've teamed up with me, I'll make sure to produce your charms to absolute perfection!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I have literally nothing BUT anxiety about this—!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: You're looking all fired up, Earth-san!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fufu, the music Royce played for me made me feel like I just had to run.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I want to stir their hearts into that kind of wild frenzy!
With running that belongs only to me!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"You truly are my guidepost. You wove for me
the musical score of the 'strongest.'"

Royce and Royce exhausted every trick in the book
to sear her impression into people's memories.
Seeing her success, more and more Umamusume began to follow her example.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Royce-san, if you don't mind... could we perhaps do a joint training session sometime?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course I don't mind!
It's fine, right, Trainer?

Even without extraordinary talent, one can become the 'strongest'.
Sharing that know-how will broaden the future for all Umamusume.

I take pride in knowing that being one of your wings
is part of my duty as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I wonder what kind of
"strongest Umamusume" Earth-san will become.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "I am still halfway along my path. We shall meet again someday—at the pinnacle of 'the strongest.'"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: “—And now, let us hear some words of enthusiasm from our two campaign ambassadors.”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I believe we were chosen thanks to
the fans who support us.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"So that many Umamusume and fans
can forge happy bonds together."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "So that watching the races becomes even more enjoyable for all the fans."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And so that many Umamusume can shine!
I intend to propose a variety of ideas!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I will now unveil a piece of calligraphy
expressing our resolve!
—Nature-san!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Well then.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: With the wish to infinitely broaden racing life for both us Umamusume and all of you—'Wide'!
(Ooooooh!)
—Who is your "strongest Umamusume"?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I vote for that mysterious, handsome girl!
I'll never forget her debut race where she overtook
the girl who went on to become a Double Tiara winner!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I am Sounds of Earth!
Her races hold the passion of music, and her music stirs memories of the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text: I'd go with Curren Bouquetd'or. Seeing her fight tenaciously until the very end inspired me. Her Tenno Sho (Spring) is my personal favorite race.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"Well, none other than the originator of this 'Strongest' path,
Royce and Royce!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
She's always so desperate and quite greedy.
And yet, seeing her like that... you just can't hate her!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan E
text_block_list.text:
She's so interesting! I just get the feeling
she's going to stir up something big!
The title of "The Strongest" that she claimed was—

You can't help but be drawn to her and want to root for her.
Perhaps she truly is the "Most Beloved Umamusume."
